plain.li: [named,wsdef:Council_WS_Plague] That fever at {PLACE} is {GOD}'s doing, mark my words.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Plague] {GOD} sent {WHAT}, and we'd better not forget it.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Comet] That comet is {GOD}'s, I'd know it anywhere.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Comet] {GOD} put that light in the sky, and not for nothing.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Bumper] A harvest like the one at {PLACE} doesn't just happen, it's {GOD}'s gift.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_GreatFire] Nobody can tell me the fire at {PLACE} was an accident, that was {GOD}.
[named,wsdef:Rimfolk_WS_ColdYear] A year without a summer is {GOD}'s doing, my grandmother lived through one too.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Famine] {GOD} has taken the bread out of their mouths at {PLACE}, and I'd like to know why.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Flood] The water rose at {PLACE} because {GOD} wanted it to.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Drought] {GOD} is holding the rain back, that's what this drought is.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_HardWinter] This winter is {GOD}'s, you can hear it in the quiet.
[named,wsdef:Council_WS_Murrain] The herds at {PLACE} are dying because {GOD} turned away from them.
[named] {WHAT} is {GOD}'s doing, whatever anyone says.
[named] I've no doubt at all that {GOD} is behind {WHAT}.
[other] No, that's {GOD}'s work, not {RIVAL}'s, and you know it.
[other] You've got it wrong, {WHAT} came from {GOD}, not {RIVAL}.
[other] {RIVAL}, really, when it's so plainly {GOD}?
[scoff] Things like that happen without anyone sending them.
[scoff] It's bad luck and bad roads, not a god.
[scoff,wsdef:Council_WS_Comet] It's a rock in the sky, nobody sent it.
[scoff,wsdef:Council_WS_Bumper] It rained at the right time, that's all a good harvest is.
